text:
sanjay (AE): FYI customer wants an air-gapped POC but flagged customs/insurance for couriered SSDs. They also want customer-held signing keys (HSM) and a strict 30d critical patch SLA. Can we confirm operational constraints + pricing?

aline (SE): We can support HSM-signed manifests. Two modes: 1) customer signs locally with HSM and we only provide tooling; 2) customer provides delegated signing token (short-lived) and we sign. Mode 1 has less vendor risk.

julia (Customer-Sec): Mode 1 preferred. Our infosec insists private keys never leave our HSM. Also need chain-of-custody paperwork for shipment and proof-of-delivery scanned to our compliance box.

tom (Legal): We'll need an amendment to the MSA covering physical media liability and customs declarations. Shipping insurance is typically billed back to the customer. Also need an indemnity paragraph for tampered media if chain-of-custody is broken.

sanjay (AE): Understood. @shipping-bot can you confirm typical shipment cadence options and sample cost line items?

shipping-bot: Standard options: economy courier (7-10 business days), expedited (2-3 bd), same-day (local only). Line items: media prep $600, per-shipment courier fee variable, insurance declared value fee 1.2% of declared. Customs paperwork prep $250 per shipment.

aline (SE): On packaging/upgrade cadence: recommend base bundle + weekly delta minibundles during POC. For production, we'd recommend monthly maintenance bundles unless customer needs accelerated hotfix retainer. Weekly is doable but increases operational load and per-shipment fees.

julia (Customer-Sec): Security Q: how are manifests verified on our side? We need a deterministic command and log output for audit.

aline (SE): Provide redwood-verify v0.9 binary and a canonical invocation. Sample output: 

```
$ redwood-verify --manifest=manifest.yaml --trusted-cert=customer_hsm.pub
manifest: ok
chunks: 3 verified
signature: valid (signed-by: customer-hsm-id-0xA7)
checksums: ok
```

Logs should be retained in /var/log/redwood/verify.log and we ship a signed copy in the manifest bundle.

julia (Customer-Sec): Good. Also need rollback plan: if a minibundle fails, we must be able to revert to previous runtime within 2 hours.

aline (SE): We'll include a fail-safe small quantized runtime and a rollback script. Rollback will restore previous rootfs snapshot and restart services. We'll document expected RTO ~45-90 minutes depending on model size.

tom (Legal): On key custody: we can accept customer-supplied public keys for verification in the bundle. Any key exchange process must include an auditable fingerprint step performed during a VC. We'll add that to the SOW.

sanjay (AE): Pricing draft for POC: base POC fee $12.5k (includes one base bundle, remote install support, 2-week runway). Add-ons: per extra minibundle $1.2k (includes media prep + manifests), onsite engineer per week $4k, emergency hotfix retainer (30d SLA) $6k. Shipping/insurance billed separately.

julia (Customer-Sec): Can we get a reduced minibundle fee if we accept larger single SSD once instead of many weekly shipments?

aline (SE): Technically yes. Tradeoff: larger monolith increases verification time and rollback risk. Delta minibundles are safer operationally. We can offer a 20% discount on per-bundle fee if they accept monthly single shipments during POC.

shipping-bot: NOTE: customs forms required: ECCN classification (we use EAR99 baseline, but certain quantized runtimes may require review), commercial invoice, chain-of-custody PDF, and carrier-specific manifest. Lead time +2 business days for export signoff.

julia (Customer-Sec): Important: our compliance team will require an export classification confirmation in writing before signing.

tom (Legal): We'll coordinate with export counsel. Add a clause: vendor to provide reasonable assistance for export compliance but customer retains final responsibility for local import rules.

sanjay (AE): Action items: 1) @aline produce POC runbook (packaging steps, verify+rollback scripts, sample manifest). 2) @tom draft MSA amendment + SOW lines for media liability and key exchange fingerprinting. 3) @shipping-bot produce estimated shipping cost table for economy/expedited. 4) @julia to route export/classification requirement doc.

aline (SE): ETA runbook draft 4 business days. Will include sample manifest and a short checksum verification playbook plus smoke-test checklist. Example ship manifest snippet included in runbook:

```
ship_manifest_id: POC-2026-04-05
items:
  - type: ssd-encrypted
    serial: SSD-21345
    size: 3.6TB
    declared_value: $5000
coi: COI-POC-987654 (chain-of-custody pdf)
```

sanjay (AE): Follow-up: customer also asked about SLA bump to cover regulatory audit window. If they want audit support during POC (access to our logs + an engineer on call during their audit) that's an additional $2k/day.

julia (Customer-Sec): We'll review internal budget but need that option. Also will share security questionnaire (SQ) this afternoon.

shipping-bot: Ticket created: SHIP-3412 with preliminary cost estimate attached.

tom (Legal): I'll draft the MSA amendment and circulate for redlines once @julia confirms export classification.

sanjay (AE): Thanks all. Let's reconvene after runbook posted. :rocket:
